lines: That sentence split like cheap stitching.
I have seen split stitching with more sense than that.
Even raw hide is easier to work with than you.
Your manners could chafe through a saddle.
You come apart the moment anyone pulls on your story.
A rotten strap has a firmer grip on reality.
That thought needs patching before you show it around.
Your temper is stiff, cracked, and badly cured.
I would not trust your judgment to fasten a buckle.
You have all the charm of wet hide in summer.
Even a torn boot knows when it has gone too far.
Your good sense wore through before your soles did.
That remark was a bad cut from worse material.
I could finish a saddle before finding your point.
You make the tannery smell welcoming.
A frayed strap shows more discipline than you.
Your confidence needs oiling and perhaps replacing.
That was not sharp. It was only poorly edged.
You are why I test every fastening twice.
I have scraps on my floor with better prospects.
Do not mock work that lasts longer than your manners.
Keep your hands off my bench if you cannot respect the work.
You would complain about the fit before letting anyone measure you.
I make useful things. What exactly do you contribute?
The hides arrive rough. You somehow arrived worse.
If noise were craftsmanship, you would be a master.
I would explain the trade, but patience is already wasted on you.
You treat every conversation like a door you need to kick open.
Go bother someone whose work can survive your help.
My dullest knife still has a clearer purpose than you.
You have mistaken rudeness for strength again.
Try listening before your mouth ruins another good moment.
I can repair a split seam. Your attitude is beyond my tools.
Nothing in this tannery needs your opinion that badly.
If you came to sneer, you can leave the same way you entered.
I have orders to finish and no time to cure your manners.
Every word from you lands like grit under a heel.
Do not lean on that rack. I trust it more than I trust you.
You make honest work look restful.
Say something useful or let me return to the hides.
